params.body:
The report editor in Curate, calmer, with the release date as a real choice.

- **Comes out**: a month (a month picker) or no date yet. The site already showed a date typed into "Announced as" ("December 2026") as the date; now the editor asks for it that way. A status typed before in other words stays, shown as "as written: …". One line says what the site shows until a file is on the shelf.
- Title and summary first, then when it comes out and its code, then Save with the slug beside it: one column instead of a grid of four with long hints.
- The file: one line on what is there, the previews, then choose, pages open to anyone, upload. "Take the file off the site" is a quiet link at the far end instead of a red button beside Upload, and the long italic note is one short line.
- The Reports tab sat up under the tab band (a negative margin pulled it there); it sits in the tab's own padding now. Labels lose their spaced capitals.

Checked locally with example rows. Build ok.
params.title: Reports: release month, calmer editor
